fold8-ultra-stable.wcfg.name: Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra, stable
fold8-ultra-stable.wcfg.description: The most stable setup tried on a Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra (12 GB / 512 GB): West Coast and Italy load well. Proton 11.0-2 x86_64, Box64 0.4.4, DXVK 2.6-2 gplasync, Turnip Gen8 V36, CPU cores 4-7.

cachyos-dd-turnip.wcfg.name: CachyOS Wine + DD-Turnip, DXVK 3.1.1
cachyos-dd-turnip.wcfg.description: Runs well on a Galaxy Z Fold8 Ultra. CachyOS Wine 11.0 rebuilt for Android (downloaded automatically), DD-Turnip v0.1.1 with 4096 MB reported memory and a GTX 1060 name, DXVK 3.1.1, Box64 0.4.4, alsa audio, 1280x720.

linux-box64.wcfg.name: Linux container, Box64 0.4.4, Turnip 26.3
linux-box64.wcfg.description: A Linux container (Arch Linux ARM runtime under proot) that runs the Linux build of BeamNG.drive 0.34 through Box64 0.4.4 with the Performance preset. Native (dma-buf) output, 800x600 with FSR 1 upscaling, 3x frame generation (needs your own Lossless.dll), the Steam client started with the container. Needs the Linux runtime, a Linux Turnip driver and Box64 installed from Components; only the settings are imported.
